issue.title: Crash on starlette middleware in mount endpoints (StaticFiles)

issue.body:
### Checklist

- [X ] The bug is reproducible against the latest release and/or `master`.
- [ X] There are no similar issues or pull requests to fix it yet.

### Describe the bug

Elastic apm tries to collect information regarding the route by accessing routes property.
the implementations of BaseRoute such as Route, Mount says the return type is `typing.List[BaseRoute]`.
In case that the app doesn't have "routes" it will return None.

### Expected behavior

routes property will return empty list

### Actual behavior

routes property will returns None

### Debugging material
```python
@property
    def routes(self) -> typing.List[BaseRoute]:
        return getattr(self.app, "routes", None)
```

### Environment

- OS: Linux
- Python version: 3.9.4
- Starlette version: 0.14.2
